summary: Verified Shred City ENCORE round feature end-to-end. All critical acceptance criteria passed: (1) encore does NOT trigger when meter not maxed - result card shows directly, shred-result-encore absent; (2) encore DOES trigger when meter maxed via __shredSetMeter(100)x3 + __shredSetTimeLeft(2) - shred-encore-label shows 'ENCORE! FLAWLESS' (pink), shred-tier-flash shows 'ENCORE!', shred-confetti-burst rendered, shred-timeleft counts from ~10s in pink, data-encore='true' on HUD wrapper, no shred-crowd-surfer anywhere (Surf Charlie successfully removed); (3) deterministic double-sticker reward logic verified by zero-input encore: result-encore line shows 'Encore: 0 notes in time, 0 slips.', shred-result-tier='SHRED LEGEND', jma_stickers_v1 contains 'shred_legend' but NOT 'shred_encore' (correctly withheld since <8 hits); (4) Sticker Book shows the 'Encore!' sticker in milestones category (locked when not earned); (5) PLAY menu PLAY_TILES[1] = SHRED CITY confirmed in source (correct 2nd tile); (6) no pageerror thrown during intro / playing / encore / result transitions. Regression items (tier label progression at 22/58/90) could not be measured in automation because a 'YOU RANKED UP' modal blocked the second song attempt, but tier label code & thresholds unchanged from previous iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: ShredLegendPage.js is 854 lines — approaches the recommended 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the HUD, result card, and encore controller into sub-components in a future refactor.
React key-warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' observed in console during encore (likely StageLights or confetti burst keys). Not blocking but worth deduping keys.
AnimatePresence mode='wait' warning fires when multiple children animate — harmless but noisy.
seed_data_creation: localStorage: jma_unlock_all_v1='1', jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1'; cleared jma_stickers_v1 before run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Encore flow confirmed working. Dev hooks window.__shredSetMeter and __shredSetTimeLeft are exposed only during the 'playing' effect — pump __shredSetMeter(100) three times with 60ms gaps to beat the 0.5/100ms decay before calling __shredSetTimeLeft(2). To test tier labels in a 2nd song within same run, first dismiss any 'YOU RANKED UP' modal (click 'Keep playing!' button) that appears after achievements unlock. Sticker hint text is not in DOM until sticker tile is clicked (opens detail view).
